answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the timber queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1130 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lotus. The velvet index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 345 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
